provenance.note: Entity 1 of the deposited asymmetric unit of entry 5SYF, kept as its own chain: the alpha-tubulin chain, from Sus scrofa, reconstructed by cryo-electron microscopy at 3.5 Angstrom. Its sequence is 437 residues and 426 of them are modelled, in 3,343 atoms. Every retained line is a deposited line; no coordinate is altered, and nothing is added. Chapter 3 contact patches use protein heavy atoms within 4.5 Angstrom in 5SYF model 1; see repository docs/microtubule-contact-faces.md for partner operators, exact author residues and source digest.
